precondition: complete 360-pair exact table and fixed 105-node GK15 component gate PASS
material_output_change: At least one energy has absolute F2-FROZEN/F2-RHO indexed reaction-loss ratio minus 1 greater than 0.01, and the absolute area difference exceeds 10 times the sum of both lanes' embedded summed error estimates.
material_author_improvement: Both all-six and dominant n=2,3 multiplicative log-RMS against the pinned Appendix-A oracle decrease by at least 5 percent relative to F2-RHO.
case_a: material output change AND material author improvement
case_b: material output change AND NOT material author improvement
case_c: all energy indexed-loss relative changes <= 0.01 and each absolute change <= 10 times both lanes' summed embedded error estimates
metric_limit: research implementation comparison, not physical validation or a continuum error bound
